versions.changelog:
- Increased context usage threshold for auto-compression from 60% to 85%.
- Updated default compression model to 'ollama/qwen2.5:3b'.
- Improved configuration documentation for clarity.

- Changed type from "skill" to "hook" in SKILL.md.
- No other changes detected.

- Initial release of context-shrink skill  
- Automatically compresses session memories when context usage exceeds 60%
- Retains detailed logs from the past 3 days; older logs are compressed into MEMORY.md
- Cleans up daily logs and performs automatic git commit after changes
